extracted.intended_audience: South Carolina-based technology startups, academic researchers, industry partners, and prospective SCRA members seeking funding, facilities, or partnership support
extracted.subtask_description: Overview page describing SCRA programs, membership benefits, funding vehicles (Industry Partnership Fund, SC Launch) and services for startups, academic institutions, and industry partners in South Carolina.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support for academic translational research and startups
rubrics_metrics.description: Provides funding and support to advance translational research and accelerate the growth of academic startups
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program focus is on translational research and academic startups—applicants should be pursuing technology commercialization or translational R&D. No specific eligibility criteria or application steps are listed on this page; see program pages for details.

rubrics_metrics.name: Access to facilities (laboratory and administrative workspace)
rubrics_metrics.description: Facilities: Offers high-quality laboratory and administrative workspaces for technology-based startups and academic institutions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SCRA provides physical workspace resources for technology-based organizations; access is tied to being a technology-based startup or academic institution and likely linked to membership or program participation (details not provided on this page).

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry partnerships and funding facilitation
rubrics_metrics.description: Industry: Facilitates and funds technology advancements and partnerships with industry, startups, and academic institutions
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SCRA acts as a convener and funder to foster industry–startup–academic collaborations. Entities seeking partnership support should be technology-focused and positioned to participate in collaborative projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coaching and funding for technology-based startups (SC Launch linkage)
rubrics_metrics.description: Startups: Coaches and funds technology-based startups that may also receive investments from SCRA’s investment affiliate, SC Launch Inc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Startup support includes coaching and funding; some portfolio companies may additionally receive loans/investments through SC Launch Inc. Participation likely requires application to SCRA or SC Launch programs (specific selection criteria not listed here).

rubrics_metrics.name: Industry Partnership Fund purpose and tax-credit incentive
rubrics_metrics.description: The Industry Partnership Fund was established to fund coaching, grants, investments, and other types of support for technology startups and academic research and development. Contributions made by individuals and organizations provide a dollar-for-dollar tax credit.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The Fund finances multiple support types (coaching, grants, investments). Contributors receive dollar-for-dollar tax credits—useful for organizations/individuals considering donations tied to tax incentives. Operational or eligibility details for funded projects are not provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: SCRA Member Benefits (access requirement)
rubrics_metrics.description: SCRA Member Benefits: Discounted Services for SCRA Member and SC Launch Inc. Portfolio Companies. Members can login to the SCRA Member Portal to access their exclusive benefits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Discounted services and other benefits are restricted to SCRA members and SC Launch portfolio companies and are accessed via a member portal. Becoming a member appears to be a prerequisite to access these benefits; the page does not list membership criteria or benefit specifics.

rubrics_metrics.name: SC Launch investment affiliation and role
rubrics_metrics.description: SC Launch Inc. is an independent, nonprofit organization affiliated with SCRA, which provides loans and investments to selected South Carolina-based companies participating in the SC Launch program.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: SC Launch functions as an investment affiliate offering loans and investments to selected participants. Selection is limited to South Carolina-based companies in the SC Launch program; further eligibility and selection criteria are on SC Launch program pages (not included here).
